summary: Phase 9 of 14 landed, green and committed, closing as [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS]. (C2') ThreadFulfilling is defined in Sharing/Predicates.lean (with fulfillingLab_of_thread, its constant-thread specialization to the deterministic (C2)), and Sharing/Fulfil.lean gains four layers: the fold relations FoldRel/FoldRelB that let a graph time and a real time be identified, FwdWalk/BwdWalk and their toThread that turn an infinite graph walk into a genuine bi-infinite Thread, (C1') propagation along a thread, and both correctness directions of the Phase 8 fixpoint against (C2') -- soundness and completeness, each unconditional. The one exclusion: the window reduction threadFulfilling_iff_window carries a LocalCoherentShare hypothesis, because the far-left case cannot be folded (the graph's backward region is a finite path, not a cycle) and is closed by (C1') propagation instead, so the plan's standalone Decidable (ThreadFulfilling S) instance is replaced by the hypothesised term decidableThreadFulfilling plus the genuine instance decidableCoherentShareAndFulfilling on the conjunction. Full lake build green (2748 jobs, exit 0), zero sorries, axiom count unchanged at 14, deterministic path and ShiftSet.lean byte-identical.
